load_data: load monolingual and parallel datasets for XLM multilingual language model training
load_binarized: load a binarized PyTorch dataset file and process it with vocabulary constraints
check_data_params: validate dataset paths, language configurations, and training step parameters
load_mono_data: load monolingual datasets with stream and batched dataset creation per language
load_para_data: load parallel bilingual datasets with sentence filtering and multi-GPU splitting
